pages.text: Removes the block at a position.

With $(1)drop$(), the block drops as an item like when it is mined. This needs allowBlockChanges or an administrator as owner, otherwise PERMISSION_DENIED is raised. An empty $(1)dimension$() in the position means the dimension of the trigger block.
$(li)$(1)position$() STRUCT c0de/minecraft/POSITION: where the block is$(li)$(1)drop$() BOOLEAN: true to drop the block as an item (optional, default TRUE)
$(1)CALL c0de/minecraft/REMOVE_BLOCK$(br)  PARAMETER position spot ;$(br)  PARAMETER drop FALSE ;$()
